tools.name: get_certificate_verification_info
tools.description: Explain how an employer can verify a ExcavationTrenchingShoring.com certificate of completion, and where to do it.

tools.name: get_price_quote
tools.description: Calculate the price for a number of seats in one ExcavationTrenchingShoring.com course, including the automatic bulk seat discount.

tools.name: list_courses
tools.description: List all training courses offered on ExcavationTrenchingShoring.com with length, price per seat, audience, topics covered, and page URL.

tools.name: recommend_course
tools.description: Recommend the right excavation and trenching course for a person based on what they do on the job. Use this when someone asks which course they need.

role.description: crew_member = works in or around excavations and trenches (laborer, equipment operator, utility or municipal crew); competent_person = foreman, supervisor, or safety manager responsible for daily inspections, soil classification, and choosing protective systems.

tools.name: search_site_content
tools.description: Search ExcavationTrenchingShoring.com content (FAQ answers, course curriculum, credential details, policies) and return the most relevant sections.

query.description: What to look for, e.g. "soil classification" or "refund policy".

tools.name: start_checkout
tools.description: Open the ExcavationTrenchingShoring.com checkout page with a course and seat count selected. The person must enter their own billing and card details and click Pay; this tool never submits a payment.
